result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock. The stock-related test classes pass, including a new regression test.

- **Fix:** `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 1489) now adds `AND s.quantity > 0` to its query. That matches the other overviews. `getQuantity` is unchanged, so asking for nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.
- **Test:** `StockOverviewTest.warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNoStock` (`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`) covers your example. It takes all nuts out of WH-1, sets screws to 0, and checks that the list shows only "Bolt 10" and that the nut quantity is still 0.

I ran `StockOverviewTest`, `StockTest`, `StockAdjustmentTest`, `StockValueTest`, `StockPerCategoryTest`, `SlowMovingStockTest` and `DashboardTest` with `mvn -o`; all pass. I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
